integrity: The proof derives the winding bound from an explicit fence lift, proves that nonzero winding forces an automorphism, and proves that zero winding forces the image into a contractible proper fence. Search non-detection is retained as residual originality risk rather than treated as novelty proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to self-maps of finite crown posets. It does not classify unequal-size crown maps or the full endomorphism monoid. Finite enumeration through n=5 is a regression check only; the proof is symbolic.
title: Self-homotopy classification of finite crown circle models
